subject: Cohort onboarding pricing: basket & central fund options for Nova Labs
messages:
From: LaunchHub Accelerator <accel-ops@launchhub.org>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-12T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Cohort onboarding: pricing/bundle options for Nova Labs cohort

Hi Lauren,

Quick intro — I run operations for LaunchHub's Spring cohort. We have a slate of ~12 startups (early-stage, mostly seed) that will be onboarded the week of May 6. Nova Labs (lead startup) is asking whether Redwood can offer a cohort-level pricing construct rather than issuing vouchers company-by-company.

Two asks from our side:
- Can you provide a "cohort basket" of promo credits we can draw from centrally and allocate across teams?
- Can credits be held centrally under LaunchHub (or Nova) and reallocated at onboarding time? Many of our startups don't spin up until after demo day.

Ballpark needs: 12 teams, expect 50k-300k tokens/month per team depending on workload (avg ~120k). We'd like an initial promo allocation that covers the first 3 months for all teams while they ramp. Also important: clarity on expiry/rollover and invoicing path (we sometimes pay one invoice on behalf of the cohort).

Can you outline options and any discounts you would attach to a 6-month cohort commitment or volume threshold? If helpful, happy to jump on a 20-min call.

Thanks — Samir
Samir Rao
Program Director, LaunchHub Accelerator
accel-ops@launchhub.org

---
Attachment: cohort_requirements_summary.pdf (stub)

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: accel-ops@launchhub.org
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-12T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cohort onboarding: pricing/basket & central fund options for Nova Labs cohort

Samir — thanks for the clear brief. Happy to propose two straightforward paths; I'll summarize here and attach a starter pricing grid.

Option A — Central cohort fund (single voucher/invoice):
- Redwood issues a single central credit pool assigned to the cohort admin (LaunchHub or Nova).
- Credits can be reallocated to startups during onboarding (admin control panel + one-time allocations).
- Expiry: default 12 months; optional 60-day post-expiry rollover for unused credits (policy exception for cohorts).
- Billing: we can invoice LaunchHub or Nova for top-ups or commit purchases.

Option B — Per-startup vouchers with cohort discount:
- Individual vouchers for each startup; easier accounting for startups but no central reallocation.
- Standard voucher expiry (6–12 months depending on promo).

Suggested promotional offer (subject to legal/finance sign-off):
- Baseline: 100k free-credit allocation per startup (12 teams -> 1.2M credits pool) for cohorts that commit to providing a 1-page usage & impact report at month 3 and month 6.
- Cohort commit discount: 8–12% on committed usage over 6 months if cohort prepays a minimum threshold (we list tiers in the attached grid).
- Overages: 10% discount on standard hosted pricing when billed through the cohort fund.

I've attached a simple pricing grid (proposed_pricing_grid.xlsx) with three tiers based on expected average monthly tokens. Ben, Mina — FYI I cc'd you for pricing floor and accounting constraints.

Next steps: If this looks reasonable, we'll draft a short MOU and a quote for LaunchHub/Nova. Samir, if you can confirm: 1) preferred billing owner (LaunchHub vs Nova), 2) whether you want padding for demo day reserved capacity, and 3) target expiry window (6 vs 12 months).

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Growth Programs, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: proposed_pricing_grid.xlsx (stub)

From: LaunchHub Accelerator <accel-ops@launchhub.org>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: samir@novalabs.io
Date: 2028-04-12T13:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cohort onboarding: pricing/basket & central fund options for Nova Labs cohort

Thanks Lauren — quick answers inline:
1) Billing owner: Nova Labs will sign and pay for the central fund on behalf of this cohort (they've committed to be the anchor sponsor).
2) Demo day reserved capacity: yes — we need the option to reserve a small guaranteed pool for demo builds and live demos (peak day traffic). Can that be isolated within the central fund?
3) Expiry: prefer 12 months with the 60-day rollover you mentioned. Many teams won't use credits until month 2–3.

A couple of additional questions:
- Can we transfer unused credits between startups mid-cohort (e.g., reallocate from a quiet team to one that needs more for a demo)?
- Is there an accounting-friendly way to receive one invoice up front, have Redwood apply credits as teams onboard, and then reconcile at month 3?

Samir

On another note — we prefer a light MOU; we can provide a template. Happy to get a draft MOU and quote so we can share with Nova's finance team this week.

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, accel-ops@launchhub.org
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-13T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cohort onboarding: pricing/basket & central fund options for Nova Labs cohort

Samir/Lauren — appreciate the clarity. From a commercial standpoint we can do the following carveouts to make this a smooth cohort offering: 

- Transferability: central fund admin (Nova or LaunchHub admin user) will be able to reassign credits between startups through the console. For accounting, each allocation creates an audit line and email confirmation.
- Reserved capacity for demo day: we can designate a small reserved pool (up to 250k tokens) that is isolated and covered by the central fund; this will consume credits only when used.
- Pricing concession: increase baseline allocation to 150k credits per startup if Nova commits to a cohort-level prepayment covering the first 3 months (we'll show numbers in the MOU). If Nova prefers pay-as-you-go, baseline stays at 100k and the cohort gets a 10% top-up on the first invoice.
- Overages and analytics: 10% discount on overage rates when billed via the central fund; cohort-level analytics included for free (usage dashboard export).

Mina — can finance sign off on a 12-month expiry + 60-day rollover exception for cohort promos (we'll capture in MOU)?

Lauren — attaching a draft MOU for the anchor sponsor path. I'll mark the commercial fields with <TO_FILL>.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

Attachment: cohort-MOU-draft.docx (stub)

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: accel-ops@launchhub.org, samir@novalabs.io
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-15T17:16:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cohort onboarding: central fund route — next steps and quote

Samir / LaunchHub — great conversation this week. Quick summary and next steps so we have an agreed path: 

Agreed commercial path:
- Central cohort fund owned by Nova Labs (anchor sponsor).
- Initial allocation: 1.8M credits total (150k per startup x12) to cover first 3 months under the prepay commitment.
- Reserved demo-day pool: 250k tokens isolated within the fund.
- Expiry: 12 months with 60-day rollover window for unused credits.
- Overages: 10% discount on published hosted rates when billed via the central fund.
- Transferability: admin can reallocate credits mid-cohort; all reallocations produce audit lines and notification emails.

Operational steps:
1) I will send a formal quote today (central-fund-quote.pdf attached) and a DocuSign link for Nova to sign the cohort MOU.
2) Once signed and payment is received, we provision the central fund and create the admin user for LaunchHub/Nova.
3) We will schedule a 30-min onboarding with each startup lead for allocation and console walkthrough the week of May 6.

Open items:
- Mina to confirm final invoicing language (prepay vs PO and reconciliation cadence).
- Legal to sign off on the MOU indemnity and data usage paragraph (we don't require custom security controls for cohort promo accounts).

Samir — if this aligns, I will send the DocuSign by EOD and loop in our legal/finance teams. Thanks again — excited to support the cohort.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Growth Programs, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

Attachments: central-fund-quote.pdf, cohort-MOU-draft.docx
